$comment: Lighthouse CI, MOBILE emulation. This is the file AC-LAND-8 names.
Run it with `pnpm lh` (build, stage content, autorun). Desktop is lighthouserc.desktop.json;
two files because a Lighthouse run has one form factor and AC-LAND-9 asks for both.
Emulation is the tool's default and is left alone on purpose: Moto G Power, 4x CPU slowdown,
slow-4G throttling. Loosening any of those would raise every number here without changing a
byte of what ships, which is the definition of a false green.
numberOfRuns 3 with the median reported: a single cold run on a shared CI box is noise, and
asserting on noise means either flaky reds or a threshold set low enough to absorb them.
assertMatrix rather than one assertion block, because the two URLs answer to different
criteria: AC-LAND-8 and AC-LAND-9 for `/`, AC-PERF-3 for `/app`. Every number below is quoted
from the blueprint. None of them is a measured value rounded down to fit.
